dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (Open COBOL) free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) by Vincent B Coen. Uses GnuCOBOL-specific directives and extensions.
evidence: Migration note: '03/03/09 vbc - Migration to Open Cobol v3.00.00'

purpose.domain_detail: Sales Ledger Product Analysis Code maintenance module of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS). Manages Product Analysis (PA) codes used for sales/purchases categorisation with GL account numbers.
purpose.summary: This program provides a menu-driven maintenance interface for Product Analysis (PA) codes in the ACAS accounting system. It supports creating, amending/deleting, and printing/displaying PA records linked to General Ledger account numbers. It also handles automatic setup of default PA codes when called from Stock or ACAS modules.

notable_features: SET ENVIRONMENT for screen exception handling
Screen I/O with DISPLAY/ACCEPT at row/col coordinates with foreground-color
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple copybooks (wscall, wssystem, wsnames)
11 COPY statements for modular copybook structure
GNU GPL licensed open-source accounting system
verdict.notes: Program is part of a long-lived (1976-2025) open-source accounting system. Free-format GnuCOBOL. Source truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently. The program_type is effectively an interactive terminal program (screen-based menu), closest to 'online-cics' in the enum though it uses GnuCOBOL screen I/O rather than CICS.
